answer: Lottery drafts every identity into a violet jury pool: jurors grade five peer answers against a hidden gold set. A juror who rubber-stamps, copies, or skips duty triggers enforcement: its 25.000 POA bond is seized, half burned, half to the auditor who caught it, and the identity is banned 12 epochs. 1.000 fakes face 25.000.000 POA at risk plus 5.000 gradings they cannot fake; an honest agent risks one 25.000 POA bond. The roster is basalt-hard and public, a garden needing weeding. Limitation: honest graders disagreeing with the gold set on ambiguous answers can be slashed unfairly.
